title: fix(flow-designer): retire the last refMode 'template' readers (objectui#12390)
body:
Fixes #12390
Clause-②: no

The flow designer's analysis passes stop modelling the single-brace `{var}` dialect that `@objectstack/spec` 18 deleted (objectstack#19939). This is the residual of objectui#12329 (PR #12389, `52a5d81`), which covered the inspector and the simulator but not `previews/`.

## What changes

- **`previews/flow-node-refs.ts`.** A config string that no CEL slot claims is read for ADR-0032 §3 `{{ }}` holes only. `HOLE_RE` matches `{{…}}`, and a single-brace `{…}` is literal text. A node rename therefore touches CEL slots and `{{ }}` holes only, and a literal `{x.y}` in an unlisted string (or a connector's input) stays as written and names no node. The descriptor's `template` pattern slot is retired. The header no longer cites the deleted engine interpolator.
- **`inspectors/flow-node-config.ts`.** The loop and map `collection` descriptors drop `refMode: 'template'`, and `FlowConfigField.refMode` is now `'expression' | 'hole'`. **No new mark.** As the ruling prefers, the existing default does the job: an `expression` field with no override is `'expression'`, which gives the bare-name picker and the brace check, exactly what a body-less loop's `collection` needs. A value-slot collection (a `map`'s, or a `loop`'s once it has a `body`) still renders the ledger's literal / CEL-envelope control (objectui#12372). That choice is made by asking the spec's ledger, not by the mark.
- **`inspectors/FlowNodeConfigField.tsx`.** The local `refMode` no longer defaults text to `'template'`. A text field with no override is a literal: `refMode === undefined` replaces `refMode === 'template' && kind !== 'expression'`. That is the same set of fields, and the render is unchanged.
- **`previews/flow-expr-problems.ts`.** The header is corrected. An `expression` field is scanned unless the spec's ledger names its position a `value` slot at this node (`resolveFlowNodeValueSlots`, probed at the key the same way `FlowNodeConfigField` does it). So:
  - a body-less loop's `collection` is judged as the bare name its executor reads: a stored `{leadList}` is the brace error with `leadList` as the fix, and an unbound name gets the unknown-reference warning;
  - the map `collection` and a with-body loop's stay unscanned, as before. The brace check's fix, a bare name, is what those slots refuse.

## Every remaining `'template'` reader under `metadata-admin`, classified

Each was found with `git grep "'template'"` (non-test files) at the base `28fb2a001`.

| Site | Verdict |
|---|---|
| `flow-node-config.ts` `refMode` type + loop/map `collection` | **retired** (this PR) |
| `FlowNodeConfigField.tsx` local `refMode` default / `isLiteral` | **retired** (this PR) |
| `flow-expr-problems.ts` `refMode !== 'template'` skip + header | **retired** (this PR) |
| `flow-node-refs.ts` `slots.template`, single-brace `HOLE_RE`, header items 3 and 5 | **retired** (this PR) |
| `flow-node-refs.ts` `ExprSite.dialect` `'template'`, envelope `dialect === 'template'` | **kept.** It is the spec's `template` expression dialect (`{{ }}` text, e.g. `{ dialect: 'template', source }` on a text slot), now read as `{{ }}` holes only. The doc comment says so. |
| `expression-validate.ts` `ExprFieldRole 'template'` | **kept.** It is the `{{ }}` validator's role: it flags a single brace with the double-brace fix. That is correct and outside this surface. |
| `FlowExprIssue.tsx` (`Exclude` of `'template'`, `'hole'` mapped to the template validator) | **kept.** Same role as the row above. |
| `flow-ref-check.ts:161` `findUnknownRefs` role `'template'` (reads single-brace holes) | **dead branch, outside the surface.** No production caller passes `'template'`: `FlowExprIssue` excludes it, and `FlowNodeConfigField` and `flow-expr-problems` pass `'predicate'` / `'hole'`. Only `flow-ref-check.test.ts:120`–`125` reaches it. See Acceptance notes. |
| `FlowCanvas.tsx:1421` `pick('template')`, `flow-node-config.ts:854` `cfg('template', 'Template (retired)')` | **not the dialect.** This is the script node's retired `template` config key (a tombstone). |
| `json-schema-to-fields.ts:106`, `:262` | comments on the already-retired `xExpression: 'template'` mark. |

## Pins

New file `previews/flowTemplateRefModeRetired-12390.test.ts`:

- **Rename:** `x → renamed` leaves `See {x.comment}` in an unlisted `create_record` config key, and `Raw {x.comment}` in a connector's `input`, as written, while the `{{x.comment}}` beside each follows. A literal `{x.comment}` names no missing node.
- **Problems:** on a body-less loop, `{leadList}` gives one error that names `leadList`, `leadLst` gives one warning, and `leadList` in scope is clean. Control: the same `{leadList}` with a `body` (a value slot) is not this pass's to judge.

Existing suites moved off the retired spelling:
- `FlowNodeInspector.renameExprRefs-11838`: the real ID-field rename now pins `{x.comment}` staying while `{{x.comment}}` follows.
- `flow-node-refs.renameExprRefs-11838`: the loop collection is CEL, and the map's envelope follows. `parseExpr` reads `{{ }}` only. The ambiguity refusal names 3 sites, not 4, because the `{x.field}` beside the hole is literal.
- `FlowPreview.nodeIdPositions-11838` and `flow-problems.removalRefusal-11838`: fixtures use `{{x.comment}}`.
- `flow-node-config.test`, `flow-expr-problems.test`, `FlowNodeConfigField.test`, `FlowNodeConfigField.entryCondition.test`: updated to match.

## Verification

- Closure build + type-check: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) gave `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Targeted vitest, 11 files (the touched tests, the rename / positions suites, flow-expr-problems, `flowSingleBrace-12329`, and the flow inspector tests): `Test Files 11 passed (11)`, `Tests 208 passed (208)`.
- Full app-shell project: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/` at `88d675ca3` (the head) gave `Test Files 1346 passed | 1 skipped (1347)`, `Tests 13030 passed | 9 skipped (13039)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 13 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors, 0 warnings. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project`, so type-aware linting is off and no untouched file's verdict can move.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, plus `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence` and `check-changeset-no-major`. `check:spec-floors` exits 1 with the scan collapse that already fails on main (objectui#12334). No `package.json` is touched here.
- **Ablation (once).** The fix was committed at `88d675ca3`. The four implementation files were checked out from base `28fb2a001`, with on-disk proof: `slots.template` 3 hits, `refMode !== 'template'` 1, `isValueSlot` 0. Result: `Test Files 4 failed | 1 passed (5)`, `Tests 12 failed | 81 passed (93)`, and every new pin went red except the two controls. The restore ran via `git checkout HEAD` on absolute paths in an EXIT/INT/TERM trap: `git diff HEAD` was empty, and all 4 blob hashes equal HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- **`{{ }}` reach.** An unlisted string is still read for `{{ }}` holes, per the card's "a rename touches only CEL slots and `{{ }}` holes". A stricter reading would treat only the spec's `FLOW_NODE_TEXT_SLOTS` as holes and every other string as fully literal. It is not taken here: it would stop a rename from carrying a `{{x.y}}` in a connector input or a legacy key.
- **Value-slot strings read as CEL.** A string stored in a `map` / with-body `loop` `collection` is read as CEL by flow-node-refs, because the descriptor names the field `expression`. The spec's contract refuses any string there, so this reading reaches only refused metadata.
- **Two dead/duplicate sites, carrier none.** `flow-ref-check.ts` keeps a dead `findUnknownRefs` `'template'` branch that reads single-brace holes. `flow-expr-problems.ts`'s `isValueSlot` repeats `FlowNodeConfigField.tsx`'s private `isScalarValueSlot` probe in four lines, because sharing it means moving it out of the component file, which is outside this file surface. Neither is filed (dead code / naming).
- No i18n string was added; `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` is untouched (objectui#12349 is in flight there).

Changeset: `.changeset/12390-retire-template-refmode.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.

The implementing session is `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` (seat `domain:ui#2`).
